title: Every General kit has a Join the list page with an email sign-up, on all seven themes
detail: The General kit of each theme carries a "join" page (slug join): Midnight uses MidnightLetter, Temple uses TempleFollow, the other five use the new neutral SpaceJoinList block (an email-only ContactFormBlock). All write a lead through the anonymous contact door and publish with the site. Asked for by Daniel through the Wizard thread.

verify.evidence: lib/sites/kits/profile-kits.test.tsx: every General kit has a join page with a sign-up block.
verify.cmd: node -e 'const f=require("fs");const r=(p)=>f.readFileSync(p,"utf8");if(!r("lib/sites/kits/profile-variants.ts").includes("joinListPage")){console.error("join page builder is gone");process.exit(1)};if(!r("components/page-editor/blocks/profile.tsx").includes("SpaceJoinList")){console.error("SpaceJoinList block is gone");process.exit(1)}'
